system.description: You are skilled at coordinating two or more separate parties during fights against Bosses. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check. On Success, the parties have Advantage on their first Attack against the Boss.

upgrades.description: You may instead use this Skill during Skill challenges while on a group Quest. Perform a free Call a Play Action, and it extends to each member of the parties during their next non-combat Skill Check.
Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Move Action.
Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Evade Action.
